composer.empty: No messages yet. Be the first!
composer.scopeLabel: Who do you want to reach
composer.quotaHelpBody: When you're a new neighbour, you can only publish a few posts per day. That's how we keep out spam and abuse without asking you to sign up.
composer.quotaHelpTrust: Over time your neighbour gains trust and the limit goes up.

privacy.title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
privacy.intro: vicinopoli is a neighbourhood square without accounts: we never ask for an email, a name or a password. Here is a plain-language explanation of what data we process.
privacy.contactBody: For questions, access or deletion requests write to:
privacy.cookiesBody1: We use a single technical cookie, “device_id”: an anonymous random identifier that lets the app work without an account. It is essential and needs no consent.
privacy.cookiesBody2: The Google Ads tag loads only after you accept the consent banner and may set advertising cookies (e.g. “_gcl_*”). You can decline and change your choice later by clearing the site's cookies.
privacy.localBody: In your browser (localStorage) we only keep functional data: the address, a message draft, notification preferences. They never leave your device beyond their intended use.
privacy.serverBody1: On the server we keep the anonymous device identifier, the published messages and a coarse geographic cell (never your address or exact coordinates).
privacy.serverBody2: With your consent we collect anonymous statistics about how you use vicinopoli. If you enable notifications, we store the subscription endpoint and the coarse cell.
privacy.noAccountsBody: We never record an email, name or password. The pseudonym is optional and your choice; it can make you recognisable, so use it with awareness.
privacy.rightsBody: Because we do not identify people, we hold no personal data to delete. For any question, write to us:
